scope: Independent Node technical checks, not a claim of browser gameplay acceptance
source: 遗迹回声_地刺版/level_manifest_threejs.json and original GLBs
checks: Both copied GLBs parse using installed three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js
LEVEL spawn, exit, player radius, player height, treasures, interaction ranges and trigger coordinates match source manifest
All preferred approaches match source interaction points within floating-point tolerance
Triggers excluded from 90 solid collider records
Invisible mesh raycast supports spawn floor
Both continuous stair ramps have upward local face normals and correct midpoint elevation
Both floor holes remain open, with next hit on a lower floor
Walkable dirt mound geometry raycast hits its raised surface with upward normal
limitations: Node geometry-only loader validation stubbed createImageBitmap; texture appearance and browser decoding require browser verification
Actual controller movement, camera behavior, collection and hazard damage need caller integration and browser testing
